en.text: Magnolia mexicana, the Mexican magnolia, is a species of magnolia that is found in parts of Mexico, Guatemala and Honduras. The flower is known in parts of Mexico as yolloxochitl, an Aztec word that loosely translates to heart-shaped flower. The Mexican magnolia, often described as having a strong beautiful scent, has been used throughout the years for its medicinal properties, as it is said to have similar compounds to that of the Digitalis medication.

es.text: El yoloxochitl es un árbol de la familia Magnoliaceae. En la época precolombina, yolloxochitl era uno de los árboles ornamentales más apreciados en los jardines de Moctezuma, por su apariencia como por sus cualidades aromáticas y hasta por sus propiedades mágicas.
